written: 2026-11-24, after the first probe and after the ingestion session's measurements of the index (sizes, headers, duplicates) and BEFORE any change to the catalog, the score or the probe's settings; unread and unscored when stamped: a FRESH set, to be scored ONCE, after the first change the first set suggested (document-frequency floor, deduplicating catalog, document kind, works table)
why: The ingestion session said any cutoff chosen after seeing the first 20 questions is a post-hoc change that needs a fresh question set. These are it. Each question is answerable from one document of Ýlir-One (English); gold = the file(s) whose text answers it, chosen by me from the documents' topics, not from any score. Three controls have no gold.

gold.q: What does the Second Amendment say?
What did Lincoln say about malice toward none?
What was the capital of the Byzantine Empire?

controls: Who is the president of Brazil?
What is the boiling point of tungsten?
rule: the same as questions.json: FOUND at k if a gold file is among the top k documents by the score; the score is the sum over the question's content lemmas (NOUN, PROPN, VERB, ADJ by the reader) of log(1 + count in the document) x log(N / document frequency). Whatever changes in the score or the catalog is declared before this set is scored; this set is scored once.
